# Categorical variable transformation
```{python include=FALSE}
import pandas as pd
import biogeme
import biogeme.version as ver

# Load Data
file_path = r"C:\Users\ohdaw\OneDrive - Harvard University\tu_data\data_reduced.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)
```

# Formatting variable
```{python echo=FALSE}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Assuming you already have a dataframe called 'data'

# List of variables to plot
variables = ["primode_cat", "TravelTimeMinutes", "PrimTargetPurp_Cat", "HousehNumPers", "HousehNumAdults", "NumChld", "PartyNumu10", "PartyNum1017", "AgeOldChld", "Chldu6", "HhStruct", "JourneyComplx", "RespSex", "RespAgeSimple"]
             
# Set plot style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Loop through each variable and create a histogram or countplot
for var in variables:
    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
    
    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(data[var]):
        sns.histplot(data[var].dropna(), kde=False, bins=20)
        plt.ylabel("Count")
    else:
        sns.countplot(x=var, data=data)
        plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
    
    plt.title(f'Distribution of {var}')
    plt.xlabel(var)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

# Formating for parameters
```{python, include=FALSE}
# One-hot encode JourneyWithChildren (0/1 format)
data = pd.get_dummies(data, columns=["JourneyWithChildren"], prefix="JWC")

# Check transformed dataset
print(data.head())
```

# Convert categorical variables
```{python include=FALSE}
# Convert categorical variables to integer codes
categorical_columns = ["primode_cat", "PrimTargetPurp_Cat", "AgeOldChld", "HhStruct", "JourneyComplx", "RespSex"]

data = pd.get_dummies(data, columns=categorical_columns, drop_first=False)

# Convert boolean columns to integers (if applicable)
bool_columns = ["JWC_0", "JWC_1", "JWC_2"]
data[bool_columns] = data[bool_columns].astype(int)

# Drop rows with missing values (or impute them if needed)
data = data.dropna() 
```

# Import database
```{python include=FALSE}
import biogeme.database as db
import biogeme.biogeme as bio
from biogeme import models
from biogeme.expressions import Beta
from biogeme . expressions import Variable

# Load data into Biogeme database
data = data.astype({col: 'int' for col in data.select_dtypes('bool').columns})
database = db.Database("JourneyChoice", data)
```

# log transforming
```{python echo=FALSE}
from biogeme.expressions import Variable, log
import numpy as np

#Define the symbolic log-transformed variable
database = db.Database("JourneyChoice", data)
TravelTimeMinutes = Variable('TravelTimeMinutes')
database.DefineVariable('TTM_scaled', log(TravelTimeMinutes))
TTM_scaled = Variable('TTM_scaled')

# Log transform TravelTimeMinutes using log1p to handle 0s
log_ttm = np.log1p(data["TravelTimeMinutes"])

# Plot the histogram
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
sns.histplot(log_ttm, bins=30, kde=True)
plt.xlabel("log(TravelTimeMinutes + 1)")
plt.ylabel("Count")
plt.title("Histogram of Log-Transformed Travel Time")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

#  If all alternatives are always available
```{python include=FALSE}
data["Avail_JWC_0"] = 1
data["Avail_JWC_1"] = 1
data["Avail_JWC_2"] = 1

database = db.Database("JourneyChoice", data)
Avail_JWC_0 = database.variables["Avail_JWC_0"]
Avail_JWC_1 = database.variables["Avail_JWC_1"]
Avail_JWC_2 = database.variables["Avail_JWC_2"]
```

```{python include=FALSE}
# Define utility functions (JWC_2 is the reference alternative, so its utility is 0)
V_0 = (
ASC_JWC_0 + 
B_time_0 * TTM_scaled +
B_primode_cat_Walk_0 * primode_cat_Walk +
B_primode_cat_Bicycle_0 * primode_cat_Bicycle +
B_primode_cat_PublicTransport_0 * primode_cat_PublicTransport + # base = Motorized Transport (car)
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_HomeResidence_0 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_HomeResidence  +
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_WorkBusiness_0 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_WorkBusiness +
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_ErrandsShopping_0 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_ErrandsShopping +
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_LeisureSocial_0 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_LeisureSocial +
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_Education_0 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_Education + # base = chauffeuring (Pick Up/Drop Off)
B_numA_0 * HousehNumAdults +
B_HhStruct_Couple_0 * HhStruct_Couple +
B_HhStruct_MultiAdults_0 * HhStruct_MultiAdults + # base = Single adult household
B_JourneyComplx_TripChaining_0 * JourneyComplx_TripChaining + # base = Simple Trip (one destination)
B_AgeOldChld_0to9_0 * AgeOldChld_0to9 + # base = Oldest Children is age  10-17
B_Aage_0 * RespAgeSimple + 
B_RespSex_Female_0 * RespSex_Female # base = 1 (man/boy)
)



V_1 = (
ASC_JWC_1 + 
B_time_1 * TTM_scaled +
B_primode_cat_Walk_1 * primode_cat_Walk +
B_primode_cat_Bicycle_1 * primode_cat_Bicycle +
B_primode_cat_PublicTransport_1 * primode_cat_PublicTransport + # base = Motorized Transport (car)
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_HomeResidence_1 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_HomeResidence  +
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_WorkBusiness_1 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_WorkBusiness +
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_ErrandsShopping_1 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_ErrandsShopping +
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_LeisureSocial_1 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_LeisureSocial +
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_Education_1 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_Education + # base = chauffeuring (Pick Up/Drop Off)
B_numA_1 * HousehNumAdults +
B_HhStruct_Couple_1 * HhStruct_Couple +
B_HhStruct_MultiAdults_1 * HhStruct_MultiAdults + # base = Single adult household
B_JourneyComplx_TripChaining_1 * JourneyComplx_TripChaining + # base = Simple Trip (one destination)
B_AgeOldChld_0to9_1 * AgeOldChld_0to9 + # base = Oldest Children is age  10-17
B_Aage_1 * RespAgeSimple + 
B_RespSex_Female_1 * RespSex_Female # base = 1 (man/boy)
)


V_2 = (
ASC_JWC_2 + 
B_time_2 * TTM_scaled +
B_primode_cat_Walk_2 * primode_cat_Walk +
B_primode_cat_Bicycle_2 * primode_cat_Bicycle +
B_primode_cat_PublicTransport_2 * primode_cat_PublicTransport + # base = Motorized Transport (car)
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_HomeResidence_2 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_HomeResidence  +
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_WorkBusiness_2 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_WorkBusiness +
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_ErrandsShopping_2 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_ErrandsShopping +
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_LeisureSocial_2 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_LeisureSocial +
B_PrimTargetPurp_Cat_Education_2 * PrimTargetPurp_Cat_Education + # base = chauffeuring (Pick Up/Drop Off)
B_numA_2 * HousehNumAdults +
B_HhStruct_Couple_2 * HhStruct_Couple +
B_HhStruct_MultiAdults_2 * HhStruct_MultiAdults + # base = Single adult household
B_JourneyComplx_TripChaining_2 * JourneyComplx_TripChaining + # base = Simple Trip (one destination)
B_AgeOldChld_0to9_2 * AgeOldChld_0to9 + # base = Oldest Children is age  10-17
B_Aage_2 * RespAgeSimple + 
B_RespSex_Female_2 * RespSex_Female # base = 1 (man/boy)
)

# Associate utilities with alternatives
V = {0: V_0, 1: V_1, 2: V_2}
av = {0: Avail_JWC_0, 1: Avail_JWC_1, 2: Avail_JWC_2}
```

```{python include=FALSE}
data["Choice"] = data[["JWC_0", "JWC_1", "JWC_2"]].idxmax(axis=1).str[-1].astype(int)
bool_columns = data.select_dtypes(include="bool").columns
data[bool_columns] = data[bool_columns].astype(int)

database = db.Database("JourneyChoice", data)
Choice = database.variables['Choice']
```

```{python, echo=TRUE}
# Define the logit model
logprob = models.loglogit(V, av, Choice)

# Create the Biogeme object
the_biogeme = bio.BIOGEME(database, logprob)
the_biogeme.modelName = "ChoiceModel"
the_biogeme.calculateNullLoglikelihood (av)

# Estimate the model
results = the_biogeme.estimate()
```

```{python, echo=TRUE}
print (f"HTML file: {results.data.htmlFileName}")
print (f"Pickle file: {results.data.pickleFileName}")
```

```{python, echo=TRUE}
pandasResrults
```
